blocks.content:
Established: 2015
Type: Executive Body
Chairperson: Prime Minister
Replaced Planning Commission
Promotes Cooperative Federalism
No Fund Allocation Power

items: Frequently tested: It is an Executive Body, not a Constitutional or Statutory body.
Key distinction: It has NO power to allocate funds, unlike the former Planning Commission.
Ex-officio Chairperson is always the Prime Minister.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Established in 2015 as an Executive Body.
Chaired ex-officio by the Prime Minister.
Does not possess any fund allocation powers.
